plan.notes: Source: Official Appalachian State University Four Year Guide for BS, Computer Science (degree code BS_219A), Department of Computer Science, College of Arts & Sciences, 2021-2022 edition, published at https://fouryearguides.appstate.edu/sites/fouryearguides.appstate.edu/files/CS 219A FYG_1.pdf. The four-year-guides site publishes guides by catalog year; 2021-2022 is the NEWEST CS BS edition available (the program moved to HTML program-of-study pages afterward), so catalog_year is set honestly to 2021-2022, not the current bulletin year. Transcription method: verbatim manual transcription of the semester-by-semester plan from the official PDF text (read via public web search indexing of the official PDF). Course titles cross-verified against the department's official 2023-2024 Program of Study (https://compsci.appstate.edu/sites/default/files/computer_science_-_2023-24_0.pdf) and the Undergraduate Bulletin for RC 1000 (Expository Writing), RC 2001 (Introduction to Writing Across the Curriculum), and UCO 1200 (First Year Seminar). CAVEATS: (1) Semester 6 lists 'Liberal Studies Experience Course 2' - the identical label as Semester 5; transcribed verbatim. Logically it is the third LSE course (the Gen Ed model requires 12 hours across 4 LSE courses); slot given a distinct placeholder code (LSE GEN-2B). (2) The guide's [WID] slot reads 'CS 3100 or ENG 3695'; modeled as a constrained-choice slot with options. (3) Prereq chains: the four-year guide itself states only grade-minimum notes (C in CS 1440 for CS 2440; C- in MAT 1110 for MAT 1120; calculus-ready for CS 1440/CS 1100; PRE MAT 1025 or equivalent test score for MAT 1110). Full chain prereqs (e.g., CS 3460 needing CS 2490; CS 3481 needing CS 2450+CS 2490; CS 4100 needing CS 3460 + the WID course; CS 4800 needing CS 3667 + CS 3460) follow the department's official Program of Study prerequisite listings; the guide's semester ordering satisfies all of them. MAT 1025 is the course-code form of the guide's 'calculus-ready' / 'PRE: MAT 1025 or equivalent test score' requirement; students may also meet it via a satisfactory placement/test score, so no one must literally take MAT 1025. (4) CS 4800 note: CS 4510 Senior Honors Thesis is the honors-student alternative (per guide). (5) Credit model: science sequence courses are 4-5 credits each (taken as 4 here); the final 'Free Elective 1-3' slot is taken as 3 so the plan totals the guide's stated minimum of 120 hours ('Take enough Free Electives to reach a total of 120 hours'). Students taking 5-credit science courses would exceed 120 accordingly. No courses, credits, or prereqs invented.
